text:
Started the year building a 3” quad with basically zero experience. Now this is a fully 3D printed, heavily modified Flightory Stallion VTOL with thermal, 5G connectivity, and a homebuilt battery pack I figured out along the way. The info and tools out there are wild if you just put in the hours.
#VTOL #3DPrinted #ArduPilot #FPV #Thermal
